heading: Feature
text: A discrete spatial phenomenon in a universe of discourse.

heading: Feature Collection
text: A collection of individual Features.

heading: Spatial Object
text: Anything spatial (being or having a shape, position or an extent).

heading: Geometry Collection
text: A collection of individual Geometries.

heading: Spatial Object Collection
text: A collection of individual Spatial Objects.

heading: Geometry
text: A coherent set of direct positions in space. The positions are held within a Spatial Reference System (SRS).

heading: default geometry
text: The default Geometry to be used in spatial calculations. It is usually the most detailed Geometry.

heading: has default geometry
text: The default Geometry to be used in spatial calculations. It is usually the most detailed Geometry.

heading: has size
text: Subproperties of this property are used to indicate the size of a Spatial Object as a measurement or estimate of one or more dimensions of the Spatial Object's spatial presence.

heading: coordinate dimension
text: The number of measurements or axes needed to describe the position of this Geometry in a coordinate system.

heading: dimension
text: The topological dimension of this geometric object, which must be less than or equal to the coordinate dimension. In non-homogeneous collections, this will return the largest topological dimension of the contained objects.

heading: has serialization
text: Connects a Geometry object with its text-based serialization.

heading: is empty
text: (true) if this geometric object is the empty Geometry. If true, then this geometric object represents the empty point set for the coordinate space.

heading: is simple
text: (true) if this geometric object has no anomalous geometric points, such as self intersection or self tangency.

heading: spatial dimension
text: The number of measurements or axes needed to describe the spatial position of this Geometry in a coordinate system.

text: The spatial resolution of a Geometry in meters.

heading: has length in meters

heading: has perimeter length in meters

heading: has area in square meters

heading: has volume in cubic meters
text: The volume of a Spatial Object in cubic meters.

heading: has metric size
text: Subproperties of this property are used to indicate the size of a Spatial Object, as a measurement or estimate of one or more dimensions of the Spatial Object's spatial presence. Units are always metric (meter, square meter or cubic meter).
